mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,code,name,contact_name,contact_phone,contract_start,contract_end,status,remark, revision,created_at,updated_at FROM client_org WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{clientId}
SELECT id,tenant_id,code,name,contract_start,contract_end,status,revision FROM client_org WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{clientId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE client_org SET name=#{name},contact_name=#{contact_name},contact_phone=#{contact_phone}, contract_start=#{contract_start},contract_end=#{contract_end},status=#{status},remark=#{remark}, revision=revision+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{clientId} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT revision,config_json,created_by,created_at FROM client_setting WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND client_id=#{clientId} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM client_user WHERE username=#{username}
SELECT * FROM client_user WHERE id=#{userId}
SELECT * FROM client_user WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{userId}

SELECT id,client_id,username,full_name,phone,role,grants_json,enabled,must_change_password, last_login_at,locked_until,created_at FROM client_user WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND client_id=#{clientId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE client_user SET failed_login_attempts=#{failed},locked_until=#{locked_until}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{userId}
UPDATE client_user SET failed_login_attempts=0,locked_until=NULL,last_login_at=#{now}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{userId}

UPDATE client_user SET full_name=#{full_name},phone=#{phone},enabled=#{enabled},grants_json=#{grants_json}, token_version=token_version+#{revoke},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND client_id=#{clientId} AND id=#{userId}

UPDATE client_user SET password_hash=#{password_hash},must_change_password=#{must_change_password}, token_version=token_version+1,failed_login_attempts=0,locked_until=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{userId}
UPDATE client_user SET token_version=token_version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id,name,status FROM campaign WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{campaignId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT b.campaign_id,b.client_id,b.deliver_history,b.revision,b.bound_by,b.bound_at,o.name AS client_name, o.status AS client_status FROM client_campaign b JOIN client_org o ON o.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND o.id=b.client_id WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND b.campaign_id=#{campaignId}

SELECT b.campaign_id,b.deliver_history,b.revision,b.bound_by,b.bound_at,g.name AS campaign_name, g.status AS campaign_status FROM client_campaign b JOIN campaign g ON g.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND g.id=b.campaign_id WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND b.client_id=#{clientId} ORDER BY b.bound_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO client_campaign(tenant_id,campaign_id,client_id,deliver_history,bound_by,bound_at) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{campaignId},#{clientId},#{deliver_history},#{actorId},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE client_id=VALUES(client_id),deliver_history=VALUES(deliver_history),revision=revision+1, bound_by=VALUES(bound_by),bound_at=VALUES(bound_at)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM client_campaign WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND campaign_id=#{campaignId}
mapper.select: SELECT l.id,l.from_client_id,f.name AS from_client_name,l.to_client_id,t.name AS to_client_name,l.actor_id, u.username AS actor_username,l.created_at FROM client_campaign_log l LEFT JOIN client_org f ON f.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND f.id=l.from_client_id LEFT JOIN client_org t ON t.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND t.id=l.to_client_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND u.id=l.actor_id WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.campaign_id=#{campaignId} ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT name FROM contact WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{contactId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client_lead WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND client_id=#{clientId} AND dedup_key=#{dedupKey} AND status='delivered' AND delivered_at >=#{since}
mapper.update: UPDATE client_lead SET result_code=#{result_code},intent=#{intent},summary=#{summary}, slots_json=#{slots_json},contact_name=#{contact_name},status='delivered',withdraw_reason=NULL, withdraw_note=NULL,revision=revision+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{leadId}

UPDATE client_lead SET status='withdrawn',withdraw_reason=#{reason},withdraw_note=#{note}, revision=revision+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{leadId} AND status='delivered'
mapper.sql: l.id,l.client_id,l.campaign_id,g.name AS campaign_name,l.call_session_id,l.contact_id,l.phone_masked, l.contact_name,l.result_code,l.intent,l.summary,l.slots_json,l.status,l.withdraw_reason,l.withdraw_note, l.follow_state,l.invalid_reason,l.follow_note,l.next_follow_at,l.assignee_id,au.full_name AS assignee_name,l.dispute_state,l.dispute_note,l.first_viewed_at,l.delivered_at,l.updated_at,l.revision, (COALESCE(ct.dnc,FALSE) OR COALESCE(ct.consent_state,'')='REVOKED') AS consent_revoked

FROM client_lead l LEFT JOIN campaign g ON g.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND g.id=l.campaign_id LEFT JOIN contact ct ON ct.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND ct.id=l.contact_id LEFT JOIN client_user au ON au.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND au.id=l.assignee_id

SELECT COUNT(*)
WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.client_id=#{clientId}

SELECT COALESCE(ct.phone,c.phone) FROM client_lead l LEFT JOIN contact ct ON ct.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND ct.id=l.contact_id LEFT JOIN callsession c ON c.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND c.id=l.call_session_id WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.id=#{leadId}
SELECT c.recording_url FROM client_lead l JOIN callsession c ON c.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND c.id=l.call_session_id WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.id=#{leadId}

SELECT t.speaker_role,t.transcript,t.start_ms,t.end_ms FROM client_lead l JOIN speechturn t ON t.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND t.call_session_id=l.call_session_id WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.id=#{leadId} AND t.is_final=TRUE ORDER BY t.created_at,t.id LIMIT 500

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,COALESCE(SUM(l.first_viewed_at IS NULL),0) AS unread, COALESCE(SUM(l.follow_state='pending'),0) AS pending,COALESCE(SUM(l.follow_state='contacted'),0) AS contacted,COALESCE(SUM(l.follow_state='valid'),0) AS valid,COALESCE(SUM(l.follow_state='invalid'),0) AS invalid,COALESCE(SUM(l.follow_state='won'),0) AS won,COALESCE(SUM(l.dispute_state='submitted'),0) AS disputing FROM client_lead l WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.client_id=#{clientId} AND l.status='delivered'
AND l.assignee_id=#{assignee}

UPDATE client_lead SET dispute_state=#{dispute_state},dispute_note=#{dispute_note},revision=revision+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND client_id=#{clientId} AND id=#{leadId} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS analysis_id,c.id,c.tenant_id,c.campaign_id,c.contact_id,c.phone,a.result_code,a.intent, a.summary,a.structured_json,a.review_state,a.needs_review,a.updated_at AS analysis_updated_at FROM callanalysis a JOIN callsession c ON c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND c.id=a.call_session_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.campaign_id=#{campaignId} AND a.id >#{afterId} ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id,actor_kind,actor_id,action,detail_json,created_at FROM client_lead_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND client_id=#{clientId} AND lead_id=#{leadId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(detail_json,'$.rows') AS UNSIGNED)),0) FROM client_lead_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND client_id=#{clientId} AND action=#{action} AND created_at >=#{since}
